summary: Single piezo counter 183 on the Parramatta River north path at Atkins Rd, reading ~40-50 bikes/day per direction with a consistent profile. The Jul-Oct 2021 rise (Sydney lockdown, also seen at every neighbour) and the 17 Aug to ~16 Nov 2023 five-fold rise (traffic diverted from the adjacent Atkins St path, site 199, which fell to ~5/day in exactly those months) are real. The only changes restore zero_outage fixes that blanked genuine rain and flood-day zeros.
